reference.generator: Codex built-in image_gen (codex-cli 0.162.0-alpha.17.2, gpt-5.6-sol, reasoning medium; ChatGPT plan, no API key); the adopted chibi woman and the user style image attached to every call

chosen.design: B5: a shaggy reddish-brown woolly-mammoth-calf hood with a trunk hanging over the forehead, two small cream tusks, round ears and a cream fur trim around the face, messy dark-brown hair, blue-grey eyes, two red-ochre stripes on each cheek, a reddish-brown fur capelet with a cream trim and an animal-tooth necklace, a tan hide tunic with elbow sleeves and fur cuffs, a belt with a knot and a pouch, a red-ochre zigzag and dots above the cream fur hem, brown shorts with fur trims, bare knees, reddish-brown fur leg warmers, laced tan boots

trellis.settings: local TRELLIS-2 C++ GGUF, res 1024, tex 1024, BiRefNet matte, xatlas atlas 2048

rejected.reason: a large round tan mammoth rump with a tail invented on the back (not in the design); renders qa/dense-s123

chosen.note: no rump; the trunk, a front-view feature, comes forward and curls up as in seed 123 (the reconstruction's consistent reading of the depth); renders qa/dense-s42, qa/dense-s42-face

stopped.reason: stopped in the texture stage after seed 42 was chosen (it held the GPU for the browser QA)

blankFace.script: scripts/remake/blank_face.py --fill-mode residual with --force ellipses over the whole eyes 401,452,55,48 and 626,452,55,48, the eyelid arcs left above them by the first fill 436,409,19,10 and 589,409,17,10, the cheek stripes 396,522,31,23 and 632,523,31,23 and the mouth 514,538,34,11

reduction.script: scripts/remake/chibi_surface.sh (BUDGET=8500 BOOST=1.3 CUT=0.0935 FACEBOX=-0.13:0.13:0.095:0.26:0.03:0.21 HAIR_SAT=0.22,0.30 FACE_EXTRA=--flat-normals 1.0)
reduction.note: the hood takes 5,073 of the triangles before the merge, the body 3,413

body.settings: CIELAB quantiles to the reference rows 600-1477

tunic.script: match_reference_colours.py --mode range --atlas-range 22,32,0.24,0.37,0.72,0.93 --ref-range 25,33,0.33,0.47,0.75,0.92 --rows 600,1477: the paler tunic (saturation 0.30) onto the reference's tan (0.39)

fur.script: match_reference_colours.py --mode range --atlas-range 8,20,0.5,0.66,0.6,0.82 --ref-range 12,22,0.45,0.58,0.55,0.78 --rows 600,1477: the capelet and leg warmers a little less orange

shorts.script: scripts/remake/even_fur.py --region=-1:1:-0.262:-0.2256:-1:1 --hue 10,40 --min-sat 0.3 --keep 0.6 --chroma-keep 0.5 --target 127,85,66: the light tan shorts onto the reference brown (their cream trims untouched)

rejected.reason: a range transfer for the shorts and boots together barely moved the shorts (the range was shared with much of the atlas)

the hood renders more orange than the design, but its albedo is already a little darker than the reference's hood pixels (CIELAB L 43.9 against 47.0): a range transfer onto them lightened it and added noise; the hood is kept

face.settings: replace mode, eye and chin rows 452/590, hair guard except in the eye ellipses 401,452,70,64 and 626,452,70,64 and the lower face 514,515,80,45, dark regions thinner than 9 texels, skin tone halfway, face normals flattened

skinMaterial.script: scripts/remake/split_skin_material.py --arm 0.13,0.78,0.395,0.457 --cuff 0.645 --legs 0.255,0.31 --neck 0.83,0.88,0.09 --tone 234,182,154 (bare forearms and hands below the fur elbow cuffs, which end at 0.63-0.64 of the arm; the knees between the shorts trim and the leg warmers; --bare-arms was tried and dropped: the capelet votes as skin)
